rows.question: Under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, would it be compliant to only mention the bank’s online schedule of penal charges in the sanction letter and loan documents?
rows.answer: No: the directions require the quantum and reason for penal charges to be clearly disclosed upfront in the loan agreement and KFS, in addition to being displayed on the bank’s website under Interest rates and Service Charges.  A reference to the website schedule of penal charges in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice.  The directions also require the bank to disclose fees and charges, including penal charges, recovered from customers in Schedule 14: Other Income, and to have a Board-approved policy on penal charges.
